class.name: TickSpawner
class.brief_description: Replicates the creation and removal of nodes from the server to the clients.
class.description: On the server, [method spawn] instantiates one of [member spawnable_scenes] (or [method spawn_custom] calls [member spawn_function]) under [member spawn_path], and every client creates the same node with the same name. Removing a spawned node from the tree on the server removes it on the clients. Clients that join later receive the live spawns. The controller peer given to the spawn becomes the [member TickObject.controller_peer] of every [TickObject] of the new node, on all peers. Clients only instantiate scenes of [member spawnable_scenes] or call [member spawn_function]; nothing else coming from the network is instantiated. [codeblock] func _on_peer_ready(peer: int): $Players/TickSpawner.spawn("res://player.tscn", "Player_%d" % peer, peer) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_spawnable_scene
method.description: Adds a scene path to [member spawnable_scenes].

method.name: get_spawned_nodes
method.description: Returns the nodes spawned by this spawner that still exist.

method.name: spawn
method.description: The server of a single authority network, or any node of a distributed one. Instantiates [param scene] (one of [member spawnable_scenes]) under [member spawn_path], named [param name] (generated when empty), with [param controller_peer] as the controller of its [TickObject]s (0: this peer), and replicates it. [param data] is sent to the clients too. Returns the new node, or [code]null[/code] on failure.

method.name: spawn_custom
method.description: The server of a single authority network, or any node of a distributed one. Creates a node with [member spawn_function] called with [param data], on the server and on every client, and adds it as in [method spawn]. Returns the new node, or [code]null[/code] on failure.

members.member: Path to the [TickNetwork]. If empty, the first [TickNetwork] ancestor is used, or else the first one in the scene.
Called with the spawn's data to create the node of [method spawn_custom], on every peer. It must return a new [Node] outside the tree.
Node the spawned nodes are added to.
Paths of the scenes that [method spawn] can instantiate.

signal.name: despawned
signal.description: Emitted when a spawned [param node] leaves the tree.

signal.name: spawned
signal.description: Emitted when a [param node] is spawned, on the server and on the clients.
